meta.title: feat: implement streaming schedule loading for faster initial render
meta.body_summary: Refactors schedule loading to stream data, showing the first week of availability right away and loading the remaining weeks in the background for at least 3x faster initial render.

perf_labels.notes: Devin implemented streaming schedule loading claiming 3x speedup; no human review or benchmark, closed by bot after 10 days inactivity.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 130 changed lines across 5 files, this is a small absolute change. The PR attempted a streaming loading optimization but closed without merge, consistent with lack of review engagement.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review or comments from human maintainers; only automated bot comments.
review_details.performance_claim: At least 3x faster initial render by loading 1 week of data first, then streaming the remaining 3 weeks.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed by Devin bot due to 7+ days inactivity with no human engagement.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: A frontend data fetching optimization requiring maintainer validation; the PR received no human review and was closed automatically, indicating a process barrier where Agent PRs may go unexamined.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark data or profiling evidence; performance claim is purely narrative.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR was closed automatically after 7 days of inactivity, no fix cycle.

core_change_summary.description: Modified useSchedule hook to implement two-phase loading: first fetches 1-week range, then streams the next 3 weeks; updated useTimesForSchedule to support phased ranges; changed BOOKER_NUMBER_OF_DAYS_TO_LOAD default from 0 to 7; fixed TypeScript errors in LargeCalendar components.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: LargeCalendar and constants changes are minor (2 lines each) to accommodate the new loading strategy.
change_trajectory: Single commit implementing streaming schedule loading with phased data fetching and minor fixes.
